main.description: Get size and count statistics about an account's stored app.bsky preferences, for diagnosing oversized preferences. Never returns preference values.

bodyBytes.description: UTF-8 byte length of the JSON body {"preferences":[...]} holding every stored app.bsky preference, as app.bsky.actor.putPreferences would receive it: the size that counts against that method's request body limit. Preferences the server derives rather than stores (app.bsky.actor.defs#declaredAgePref) are excluded, though a client may send them back too.

byType.description: Stored app.bsky preferences grouped by $type, largest total size first.

count.description: Number of stored preferences of this $type.

bytes.description: Total UTF-8 byte length of their JSON serializations, excluding the separators counted in bodyBytes.

savedFeedsStats.description: Totals over every stored app.bsky.actor.defs#savedFeedsPrefV2 preference.

items.description: Number of saved feeds (entries in items).

pinned.description: Number of saved feeds whose pinned is true.

legacySavedFeedsStats.description: Totals over every stored app.bsky.actor.defs#savedFeedsPref preference.

mutedWordsStats.description: Totals over every stored app.bsky.actor.defs#mutedWordsPref preference.

items.description: Number of muted words (entries in items).
